card.name: In the Eye of Chaos
card.oracle_text: Whenever a player casts an instant spell, counter it unless that player pays {X}, where X is its mana value.

data.comment: This has the supertype world. When a world permanent enters, any world permanents that were already on the battlefield are put into their owners' graveyards. This is a state-based action called the "world rule." The new world permanent stays on the battlefield. If two world permanents enter at the same time, they're both put into their owners' graveyards.
This ability triggers when the spell is cast.
